title: Iulius Pollux
summary: Raleigh names Iulius Pollux in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iulius Pollux, cited on the finding of purple. Not Pollux of the Dioscuri. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection III, sig. 220b
